basic.title: transfer off the edge
basic.text: 2 cells move a loop left of needle 1 or right of the last needle, outside the pattern's needles.

basic.title: floats longer than 3
basic.text: A yarn guide passes more than 3 needles without a stitch in 3 passes. Long floats snag; set the limit for your gauge and yarn.

basic.title: more than 2 tucks stacked
basic.text: Some needles collect more than 2 tuck loops before they knit again; the hook may not hold them all.

basic.title: loops held over 4 passes
basic.text: Some needles keep their loop for more than 4 passes without knitting (tucks and floats). Held loops stretch, as in short rows; set the limit for your yarn.

two.title: floats longer than 3
two.text: A yarn guide passes more than 3 needles without a stitch in 7 passes. Long floats snag; set the limit for your gauge and yarn.

two.title: loops held over 4 passes
two.text: Some needles keep their loop for more than 4 passes without knitting (tucks and floats). Held loops stretch, as in short rows; set the limit for your yarn.

two.title: provisional colours
two.text: 10 cells use a colour that the lab's script hasn't confirmed yet (two-guide brown / gold).
